stem.en: A jet of mass 15000 kg lands on a ship's deck. A wire pulls back on it with a steady force of 367500 N and stops it in 100 m. What was the jet's speed just before the wire caught it, in m/s?

explanation.en: The wire does work -367500 N x 100 m = -36 750 000 J on the jet. This removes all the jet's kinetic energy, so 1/2 x 15000 x v^2 = 36 750 000. Then v^2 = 4900 and v = 70 m/s.

hints.en: The jet ends at rest, so all its kinetic energy is removed by the wire's work.
Set 1/2 x 15000 x v^2 equal to 367500 x 100.
